messages.content: ajke ekta bhalo na feeling, kintu exactly ki bolte parbo na
That happens sometimes, feelings don't always come with a clear label. Body e kothaw tension feel korcho, naki just mentally heavy lagche?
mentally heavy, chest ta bhari lagche
That physical heaviness is real, anxiety often shows up in the body before the mind even names it. Ajke ki emon hoyeche j ei feeling ta start hoyeche?
kichu e specific na, just accumulate hoyeche mone hoy
Accumulated stress often feels vague like this, no single trigger to point at. Ekta choto break nao ekhon - just five minutes chup kore boso, deep breath nao, tarpor abar kotha bolbo jodi chao.
